notes: Anomaly episodes and the evidence ladder (F0 audit section 7). An episode is a property of a place, an instrument or a time: its condition may only use time, shift, day, zone, story flags, world state and evidence, never a patient, a clinical action, a note, a staff relationship or the physician's strain. Episodes record what the story already shows; they never perform anything and never change clinical state. Readings are clues; testimony (patient_report, staff_testimony) is shown but never counts toward the ladder. Nothing here runs while forensic_ward/narrative/anomaly_enabled is false. Chapter 1 is capped at 'reported' so it stays ambiguous; later chapters' caps follow the owner-approved ladder when their content is approved.
